items.title: Joe Ascione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: in the big band era you have to listen to Jo Jones and even Chick Webb and Sonny Greer and Gene Krupa.

ctx.x: Well what I would first say is instead of just randomly picking a thousand great drummers, I would stop and say let’s take the last hundred years and partition it into

musical styles, and let’s say we come up with seven to ten styles of music. Because we have Dixieland and swing and bop and progressive and acid jazz and trad. Again labels so we could talk about things. So if we need a label, let’s pick some periods in time that the music sounded like this or that or this or that, and let’s learn how the music evolved, and then in those certain periods let’s pick one or two drummers here and one or two drummers there. You have to hear Baby Dodds. You have to hear Chick Webb. You…
